sloka: देवि हर्यृक्षसैन्यानामीश्वरः प्लवतां वरः ।सुग्रीवः सत्त्वसम्पन्नस्तवार्थे कृतनिश्चयः ।। ५.६८.१७ ।।।।
transliteration: devi haryṛkṣasainyānāmīśvaraḥ plavatāṁ varaḥ ।sugrīvaḥ sattvasampannastavārthe kṛtaniścayaḥ ।। 5.68.17 ।।।।

translations.english: 'O queen The lord of the army of bears and vanaras who is the foremost among the monkeys is endowed with enough strength and has resolved to rescue you.
